issue_context.title: Viessmann ViCare Integration: Not All Vitocharge Entities are shown
issue_context.body:
### The problem

It seems that not all entities are shown in the vicare integration. On a first look at least the entity for `photovoltaic.production.cumulated` is missing. This is the first time i use the integration, so the list may be incomplete (the setup log contains 5 errors for adding an entity).

There are some failures about incorrect unit of measurement (kWh), in the log during the setup of the integration. Because the entity seems to be `None` the root cause may be different.

```
2024-07-21 08:05:40.024 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Error adding entity None for domain sensor with platform vicare
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 598, in _async_add_entities
    await coro
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 831, in _async_add_entity
    unit_of_measurement=entity.unit_of_measurement,
                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/sensor/__init__.py", line 512, in unit_of_measurement
    if self._is_valid_suggested_unit(suggested_unit_of_measurement):
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/sensor/__init__.py", line 383, in _is_valid_suggested_unit
    raise ValueError(
ValueError: Entity <class 'homeassistant.components.vicare.sensor.ViCareSensor'> suggest an incorrect unit of measurement: kWh.
```

[full log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16323723/ha_vicare_setup_debug.log)

It also looks like that some entity names/ids are messed up, for example `sensor.e3_vitocharge_03_none` that i guess should be the entity for the current power exchange of the energy meter (`pcc.transfer.power.exchange`).

I have seen there was lately an issue, that might be related (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/122056).

---

**Installation components**
* Heatpump (Vitocal 252-A)
* Communication module (RF-Modul WiFi / LAN ready)
* Energy meter (Viessmann E380 CA)
* Inverter (Vitocharge VX3-A8.0A + 5kWh storage module)

**Viessmann API responses for the installion**
[Installations endpoint](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16323729/vi_api_installation.json)
[Device endpoint (vitocal)](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16323736/vi_api_vitocal.json)
[Device endpoint (vitocharge)](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16323731/vi_api_vitocharge.json)

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.7.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Viessmann ViCare

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vicare/
